claims.text: IDA's senior leadership includes former NSA Technical Director Christopher Green (VP, Center for Communications and Computing) and Maj. Gen. James R. Marrs, USAF (Ret.), former National Intelligence Manager for Aviation.
Adm. Charles A. Richard, USN (Ret.), is President of the Institute for Defense Analyses, having commanded US Strategic Command from 2019 to 2022.

IDA's president is Adm. Charles A. Richard, USN (Ret.), who commanded US Strategic Command from 2019 to 2022; its leadership includes former NSA Technical Director Christopher Green and Maj. Gen. James R. Marrs, USAF (Ret.), former National Intelligence Manager for Aviation.

edges.label: President of IDA after commanding US Strategic Command
edges.note: His STRATCOM tenure, 2019-2022, coincides exactly with the UAP Task Force period and the establishment of AARO.
